name: Eri
source:
An ordinary looking freshman attending Crobi Academy.

With the sudden death of her grandfather and her parents working overseas, she is left to live at home by herself.

Though gentle-hearted, she's somewhat more pessimistic and mature than girls her age.

Hobbies: Taking pictures of dolls, blogging
Likes: Grandpa, ball-jointed dolls, cup noodles
Hates: Bugs

[Edited From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
